'''Robby Duncan Sharpe''' is an American voice actor for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Sharpe joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|XY}}, where his most notable role was [[Sawyer]], one of {{Ash}}'s [[rival]]s in the [[Kalos]] [[region]].
